name: Noggenfogger Elixir
summary: Marin Noggenfogger in Gadgetzan takes the Violet Powder to mix into the dew, and asks you to come back to him in a moment, once his fabulous elixir is perfected.

sections.title: Mixing the Elixir
sections.body: Marin, who has the dew and now the powder, sets about mixing the one into the other. You are to wait a short while and then speak to Marin again, when the Noggenfogger Elixir should be ready.

sections.title: Marin's Verdict
sections.body: When Marin is done, a drink is pressed on you and declared wonderful. Marin boasts of the millions the elixir will bring, asks you to stand aside so you are not blocking business, and laughs off Sprinkle's claim of a favor as a joke.

faq.answer: It follows Delivery for Marin. Before that came The Thirsty Goblin, In Good Taste and Sprinkle's Secret Ingredient.

faq.q: What ingredients does Marin combine here?
faq.answer: Marin mixes the Violet Powder from Sprinkle into the dew.
